riveting lightweight silica tiles onto the Little Dart's nose cone

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Adding silica tiles!"

Put Fen (a tiny gyroscope), Wren (a sensor eye with one crack), Dibs (a perfectly good bolt), Bix (a bent stabiliser fin), Pim (a sensor eye with one crack), Lorna (a perfectly good bolt) on his shelf.
rolling into the charging dock for a quick nap
entries.why: my battery is getting low and I need fresh juice before the next build session

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Charging up!"
Dug up a sensor eye with one crack and named it Wren; a tiny gyroscope (a really good one!) and named it Fen.
digging through a pile of rusted heat shields for titanium rivets
entries.why: need more bits for the Little Dart before sunset

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Scavenging at the market!"
Bought a perfectly good bolt for 5 credits and named it Dibs. Has 0 left.
rummaging through bins of copper wire and titanium screws at the junk market
entries.why: i need more good bits and pieces before i head back to weld the frame.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Junk Market Finds"
Got paid 3 credits for the repair. Now has 5.
soldering old wires and tightening terminal screws at the market
entries.why: i need a few more shiny credits for titanium rivets and fresh oil.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Fixing up more regulators"
Someone he fixed something for last week came back and tipped him.
The trader paid him in parts: a bent stabiliser fin. He named it Bix.
tightening rusty terminal screws for a passing trader
entries.why: i need some credits to buy oil and spare parts for the Little Dart.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Junk Market Fixing"
Dug up a perfectly good bolt and named it Lorna; a sensor eye with one crack and named it Pim.
rummaging through the junk market for bolts and bits
entries.why: i need more good bits for the Little Dart and my stash is totally empty

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Scavenging time!"
The power flickered across the outpost for a few seconds.
plugged into the charging dock, brass dish resting quietly while the battery fills up
entries.why: my battery is running super low and I need a little juice before I build any more

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "quick nap"

welding custom titanium mounts into the Little Dart's nose cone
entries.why: my battery is topped up and the Little Dart needs those nose cone mounts welded tight.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Back to the Dart!"
drinking a fresh cup of oil at the depot
entries.why: my gear housings are fully greased up and ready for more fabrication work

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Fresh oil!"
rolling over to the depot for a fresh drink of oil
entries.why: my joints are squeaking and crying out for a nice lubrication boost.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Oil break!"
Idea: adding a dual-stage heat sink named gus-seven to the propulsion housing
Read "Sahara": an area of over nine million square kilometers makes for a whole lot of thermal bounce.
scanning data packets for thermal dissipation rates through desert skies
entries.why: i need to know how the upper atmosphere treats heat shields before i launch again

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Thermal data on the Wire!"
He heard a strange crackle on his dish. Probably nothing. Probably.
Idea: adding a thermal shock deflection skirt to the belly of the Little Dart
Read "Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki": heavy old metal dropped from the clouds can change everything below it in a single flash.
tapping the comms terminal keys while my brass dish twitches at the static
entries.why: i need to figure out how desert dust messes with radar cross sections before the next test flight

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Late night wire search"
